versions.title: Tip-Off Night

skins.name: Comet Flyer
skins.story: The star of the Harbor City Comets jumps so high that the crowd swears his teal sleeve leaves a trail across the rim.

skins.name: Frost Guard
skins.story: The point guard of the Glacier Bay Lynx never blinks behind his sport goggles, and his free throws are as cold as the bay in January.

skins.name: Canyon Center
skins.story: The bearded giant of the Red Mesa Coyotes plants himself under the basket like a canyon wall, and nothing gets past him.

versions.note: The new season tips off under the city lights, and three new players walk onto the court: a high-flying dunker, an ice-cold shooter and a centre nobody can move.

versions.title: Streetball Summer

skins.name: Park Crossover
skins.story: He learned his crossover on the cracked park court behind his building and still plays there every evening in his mesh tank and gold chain.

skins.name: Neon Night Baller
skins.story: Under the floodlights of the midnight league his lime-tipped locs and neon jersey are the brightest things on the court.

skins.name: Sunset Queen
skins.story: Nobody has beaten her at the beach court since spring, and she always plays the last game of the day as the sun goes down.

versions.note: When school is out, the real games move to the park courts: a crossover artist with a gold chain, a night baller with glowing locs and the queen of the sunset court.

versions.title: All-Star Weekend

skins.name: Slam Champion
skins.story: He won the dunk contest three years running, and the league finally gave him a golden crown to wear at every All-Star game.

skins.name: Retro Groove Guard
skins.story: He still plays in short shorts, striped tube socks and a big afro, because nobody ever told him the seventies were over.

skins.name: Midnight Owl Mascot
skins.story: The Midnight Owls never win the title, but their purple owl mascot flips, dances and dunks so well that the fans only come to see him.

versions.note: The best players of the season meet for one big weekend: the crowned slam champion, a retro guard straight out of the seventies and the owl mascot who steals every show.
